summary: Iteration 42 regression on PREVIEW: shared identity resolver, recursive Manager scope, fail-closed filters, list-vs-stats parity, Daily Tracking Sheet for growth_partner-role users, CSV export scoping+auth. 73/73 backend pytest PASS. Admin frontend smoke: /admin/files renders Total Files=514 matching backend. All baselines from review request confirmed: Admin=514, Manager Teja=94 (recursive; up from 46), Manager Saikiran=56, TL Anusha own=14/team=42, TL Pinky=32, GP Nithin=15. Admin tl_id filters: Anusha=42, Pinky=20; gp_id=Nithin=15. Fail-closed verified for bogus manager_id/tl_id/gp_id/assigned_to: list=0 and stats all-zero. List-vs-stats parity holds for empty/status=file/loan_type=Home Loan/search=a. Daily Tracking Sheet contains Meghana, Pinky, Anusha with no duplicate rows. HR blocked from files (total=0). Users list exposes source/can_login/has_password/has_password_hash/has_connect_id. Reports smoke across Admin, Ops, Manager, TL, GP for 9 report endpoints - zero 5xx.

rca of the issue: All four scoped fixes from the request verified: (A) UserIndex union-find pulls duplicate 'Teja' identities together so his recursive tree returns 94 files instead of 46; (B) descendants() traverses through TLs and sub-managers (Saikiran under Teja) giving Teja the full downward subtree; (C) build_files_query returning None -> get_all_files returns empty list & get_files_dashboard_stats returns EMPTY_DASHBOARD_STATS(), verified for unknown manager_id/tl_id/gp_id; (D) list, stats, and export all call the same build_files_query producing identical populations - verified equal totals for 4 filter combinations. Daily Tracking Sheet fix (removing hardcoded role='telecaller' + str(_id) OR id match) confirmed by presence of Meghana/Pinky/Anusha and absence of duplicate rows.
